resolution_notes: base_url: AUDITOR RIGHT. Official Apr 28 2026 announcement: api.openrouteservice.org deprecated; shut-off Aug 24 2026; core routing base is https://api.heigit.org/openrouteservice (https://ask.openrouteservice.org/t/deprecating-api-openrouteservice-org-in-favour-of-api-heigit-org/7912). free_tier_limits: ORIGINAL STANDS. HeiGIT Standard (free) still Directions V2 quota_max 2000/day, rate 40/min; 10000/day & 60/min are Collaborative, not free Standard (https://account.heigit.org/info/plans; plan data in account SPA). rate_limits: ORIGINAL STANDS for same reason — free ~40/min & 2000/day directions still current on Standard. example.request: AUDITOR RIGHT — update host to api.heigit.org/openrouteservice before Aug 24 shut-off (same announcement URL). status: still operational (shutdown not yet occurred as of 2026-08-08).
